_label: FIXTURE design-pattern library for App Lab research. Each entry names a widely used product pattern and why it tends to work; claims are qualitative and must be checked against the cited sources before relying on them. Live evidence (App Store chart positions) is attached when the Research Division has real findings.

patterns.title: Streaks and a small daily goal
patterns.why: A visible streak and an achievable daily target give people a reason to come back tomorrow; a 'freeze' keeps one missed day from ending it.
plan: Track a per-user daily goal and streak count
Show the streak prominently on the home screen
Add one streak freeze per week

patterns.title: First-run checklist that ends in a win
patterns.why: A short checklist that ends with the user's first real result (not a tour) shortens time-to-value, which is when people decide to stay or pay.
plan: Add a 3-4 step checklist on first launch

patterns.title: Ask to upgrade right after a moment of value
patterns.why: Offers shown right after a user succeeds convert better than offers shown before they understand the product, and feel less pushy.
plan: Show a dismissible upgrade card there, not at launch
Explain the one feature it unlocks
Never block the free core flow

patterns.title: Celebrate progress with feedback that feels like play
patterns.why: Immediate, delightful feedback (animation, sound, a level-up) turns routine tasks into a loop people enjoy repeating.

patterns.title: Small, friendly leaderboards
patterns.why: Comparing with a small group of peers (not the whole world) motivates without discouraging newcomers.

patterns.title: A home screen that resumes where you left off
patterns.why: Putting the user's last activity and next step first removes friction and is a common trait of highly engaged apps.
